# Preliminary Stage

This R Markdown document loads the portfolio, imports stock-market data, calculates the required descriptive statistics, and displays stock charts.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(quantmod)
library(TTR)
source("technical_analysis.R")
```

# Portfolio

```{r portfolio}
readLines("portfolio.txt")
```

# Load Stock Data

```{r load-data}
stocks <- load_stock_data()
names(stocks)
```

# Display Imported Data

```{r display-data}
display_stock_data(stocks)
```

# Calculate Statistics

```{r statistics}
statistics <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(stocks), function(symbol) {
    calculate_statistics(stocks[[symbol]], symbol)
  })
)
statistics
```

# Visualizations

```{r charts}
for (symbol in names(stocks)) {
  plot_stock(stocks[[symbol]], symbol)
}
```
